notes: ACCESS: www.conforama.fr 403s to plain requests (Cloudflare, incl. a Turnstile sitekey seen in page config). Bypassed with curl_cffi impersonation; chrome124 and safari18_0_ios both consistently returned 200 (other Chrome/Safari/Edge profiles all 403'd). Individual /_next/static JS chunk requests intermittently 403'd under burst fetching but succeeded on retry with a Referer header + pacing (~1 req/sec) -- treated as rate-limiting, not a hard block. SITE: Next.js App Router SSR site; category listing pages embed full product results server-side inside React Server Component streamed payload (self.__next_f.push(...) script tags), including per-product objectID/code/productName/price and a root PLP object carrying {"nbPages":N,"productCount":M}. Product identity uses Algolia-style objectID (generic Algolia JS SDK is bundled but appears used for autocomplete, not the PLP fetch, which is done server-side and pre-rendered). QTY VERIFICATION (Rule 1): productCount was cross-checked against the empirical page-count exhaustion formula ceil(productCount/60)==nbPages (page size 60 confirmed stable via literal product-tile objectID counts on sampled pages) for every single row below -- all 22 rows passed exactly, so productCount is treated as EXACT, not assumed. Additionally for Mirrors, the parent rollup 'Tous les miroirs' (All Mirrors, 3870) was checked against the sum of its three sibling mirror categories (Wall 2032 + Standing/Cheval 143 + Bathroom 1689 = 3864, within session-drift tolerance of 3870) confirming it is a pure superset rollup -- dropped per de-dup rule, not emitted as a row. Counts include Conforama's own stock plus its Mirakl third-party marketplace inventory (confirmed via the 'Vendu par' seller facet on Wall Mirrors: Conforama 110 + Partenaires 1922 = 2032), which explains why some numbers are large; this is what the category URL itself reports, so it is kept per 'qty is the exact number the website itself reports for that URL', not treated as inflation. EXCLUDED (product-type / mixed-rollup / not-decor, verified by reading actual product titles per Rule 0/decision rule): 'Accessoires electriques' (050108, light bulbs, connected bulbs, LED ribbon spools -- bulbs/wiring, standing exclusion); 'Veilleuse bebe et mobile musical' (060210, sampled titles were dominated by gaming headset stands, neon gaming signs, alarm clocks and toys with only a minority of true nightlights -- mixed rollup, dropped, not primarily lighting); 'Bougie, huile, encens' (050907, sampled titles overwhelmingly scented Yankee Candle products + an air-freshener spray -- home fragrance exclusion, no separate unscented child node exists); 'Panneau mural' (050906, sampled titles overwhelmingly acoustic/room-divider wall panels -- functional acoustic treatment / furniture-adjacent, not decor); 'Stickers et papier-peint' (050904, sampled titles overwhelmingly wallpaper, window film and adhesive furniture vinyl -- wallpaper/wall-covering standing exclusion); 'Boite et corbeille' (040203, sampled titles were kitchen storage boxes/jars/lunchboxes -- functional storage, not decor); 'Plat, saladier, moule' (040207, sampled titles dominated by baking molds/oven dishes/bakeware with only a minority of decorative bowls, not separable -- mixed rollup, functional cookware dominant); 'Autre objet de decoration' (050911, sampled titles mixed genuine wall-decor pieces with room-divider screens (furniture), faux/artificial plants (standing exclusion) and toys/games -- mixed rollup, dropped); 'Tringles et accessoires' (050510, sampled titles were curtain rods mixed with mattress protectors, anti-bedbug spray and a shoe cleaner -- polluted junk-drawer node, not cleanly curtain-rod, dropped despite curtain rods being an explicit include type). Also excluded on sight without a titles check: all textile nodes (linge-de-lit/maison/table/toilette, tapis), all furniture and bathroom-fixture nodes under 'Cuisine & salle de bain' other than the bathroom-mirror leaf, all appliance/TV/multimedia/garden-tool/DIY sections. ROOM OVERLAP (Rule 0.6): Bathroom Mirrors (from the Cuisine & salle de bain branch) overlaps with the 'Miroir' parent's rollup (see above) but is a genuine separate nav branch at a different site location, so it is kept as its own row per Rule 0.6. Desk Lamps (from Bureau/office branch), Kids Lighting (from Enfant/bebe branch) and Outdoor Lighting (from Jardin branch) are ROOM-based lighting nodes that a room-word filter would have skipped; per Rule 0 they were kept as their own Lighting rows despite sitting in unrelated top-level site sections (Office, Kids, Garden) rather than under the site's own 'Luminaire' parent -- this is exactly what Rule 0 is meant to catch. LANGUAGE: all category/sub_category values below are English translations of the site's own French node names; original French text is preserved in each row's evidence string.
